preconditions.description: n is an even integer between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(even_indices) == n // 2 and all(1 <= x <= 2 * 10**5 for x in even_indices)
preconditions.description: even_indices is a list of exactly n/2 positive integers, each between 1 and 2*10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: stdin_lines := stdin.strip().split('\n'); n == int(stdin_lines[0]); even_indices := list(map(int, stdin_lines[1].split()))
preconditions.description: stdin is parsed into n (first line) and even_indices (second line, space-separated integers).

postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, stdout is 'No'. Otherwise, stdout is 'Yes' followed by a line of n space-separated integers representing the restored sequence.

postconditions.expression: if stdout.strip() == 'No': True else: (reconstructed := list(map(int, stdout.strip().split('\n')[1].split())); all(reconstructed[i] == even_indices[i//2] for i in range(1, n, 2)) and all(is_square(sum(reconstructed[:t+1])) for t in range(n)))
postconditions.description: If stdout is 'Yes', the reconstructed sequence matches the given even-indexed values and all prefix sums are perfect squares. Otherwise, stdout is 'No'.

postconditions.expression: if stdout.strip() == 'No': True else: all(1 <= x <= 10**13 for x in list(map(int, stdout.strip().split('\n')[1].split())))
postconditions.description: If stdout is 'Yes', all elements in the reconstructed sequence are positive integers between 1 and 10^13 inclusive.
